scripts.build: bun build extension/src/background.ts extension/src/app.ts --outdir extension/dist --target browser
scripts.package: bun run build && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/browspark-extension.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../dist/browspark-extension.zip manifest.json app.html app.css assets dist && cd .. && ls -la dist/browspark-extension.zip
scripts.release: bun publish --access public && for a in aliases/*; do (cd $a && ([ "$(bun -p 'require("./package.json").version')" = "$npm_package_version" ] || bun pm version $npm_package_version --no-git-tag-version) && bun publish --access public); done
